engine.scope: scalar autonomous constant-coefficient 1D PDE, uniform periodic spatial grid
engine.data_class: clean external numerical reference benchmark; not real measurements
engine.polynomial_products: 2*Nx zero-padded multiplication then truncate and project
engine.nonlinear_transport: u*u_x represented equivalently as one half d_x(u^2)
engine.time_regression: local integrated equations using original-time cumulative Simpson quadrature
engine.feature_normalization: training column RMS and training target RMS
engine.debias: least-squares on selected normalized support, rcond=1e-10
engine.eligibility: all contributing LASSO fits converged, support full column rank, finite coefficients
engine.forecast: Cox-Matthews ETDRK4, diagonal Fourier linear operator, stable complex phi functions
engine.forecast_initial_state: same fixed 2/3 Fourier projection of supplied initial frame
engine.forecast_inputs: coefficients, coordinates, initial frame only; no future observations
engine.forward_operator_guard: highest nonzero even spatial derivative must be dissipative; negative second derivative allowed with negative fourth derivative
engine.forward_growth_guard: finite states, maxabs <= max(100,1000*initial_maxabs); no truth-specific coefficient bounds

candidate_selection: development RMSE <= 1.05*best, then fewest terms, RMSE, candidate_id
prediction_inputs: final-segment initial spatial field, x and requested times only

burgers.note: The official PySINDy feature overview uses periodic=True on the byte-identical source MAT file; original generator is absent.

kdv.note: Supplement section 3.1.1 states spectral generation but does not explicitly specify boundary conditions. A periodic numerical closure must be declared as an implementation assumption, with a train-only edge consistency check; original generator is absent.

ks.note: Official PySINDy PDE-FIND examples explicitly use periodic=True for this byte-identical MAT file; author supplement section 3.5 describes spectral generation, but original generator is absent.

reference_role: structure/coefficient scoring only, parsed after global freeze verification
